title: Seahawks keep Shaheed in fold with $51M deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Seahawks keep Shaheed in fold with $51M deal
sources.description: The Seahawks are bringing back wide receiver Rashid Shaheed on a three-year, $51 million deal that includes $34.7 million guaranteed, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Robert Bailey told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.
